board.title: The plants are still the scarce thing
board.story: The factories that make the chips were not built fast enough. That shortage is still the brake.

board.title: The circular paper of that build may not hold
board.story: If ordinary funding is exhausted, the stack starts lending to itself. That can look like a boom on paper.
board.force: the paper of the build can break

board.title: Power is the problem. Nobody agrees what happens next.
board.story: The problem is agreed. The path is not. The world will pick by what actually fails first.

theses.title: They keep building, and the plants stay scarce
theses.claim: The factories stay the brake. A scare in the shares is not a factory event.

theses.title: The circular funding of that build will not hold
theses.claim: One of the alternative deals will break in public. A podcast complaining is not enough.
